headings: If You Had Tomorrow to Do Over Again, Would You?
core_concepts: If You Had Tomorrow to Do Over Again, Would You?
But not if we continue to settle, continue to hide, and continue to scurry along the same paths
But it can’t happen and won’t happen if we can’t figure out how to trust ourselves enough to do the work
